# Eryx Fitness

> > Eryx Fitness manufactures adjustable, portable fitness equipment including the OneBell® kettlebell system, OneClub® clubbells, and OneMace® macebells for functional and strength training.

Eryx Fitness specializes in modular training equipment that combines portability with versatility, featuring proprietary adjustable systems like OneBell® (12-32kg kettlebells), OneClub® (6-16kg clubbells), and OneMace® (4-30kg macebells). The site offers comprehensive training guides covering kettlebell techniques, Girevoy Sport, CrossFit WODs, and sport-specific physical preparation programs.

## Key Topics

- OneBell® adjustable kettlebell system
- OneClub® adjustable clubbells
- OneMace® adjustable macebells
- Girevoy Sport (kettlebell sport)
- Functional training & hybrid training
- Kettlebell swing technique
- Flow Pack & Strong Pack bundles
- Hardstyle kettlebell training
- CrossFit kettlebell WODs
- Competition kettlebells
- Ballistic movements vs grinds
- Sport-specific physical preparation
- Adjustable fitness equipment
- Portable training systems
